～日|～にち.note: After a number or a weekday: 日曜日 (Sunday), 三日間 (three days). Also the date suffix in 十一日 (the 11th).

日|ひ.note: On its own: a day or the sun. 次の日 (the next day), 日が昇る (the sun rises). Voiced as び in 誕生日.

日|にち.note: In compounds and counting: 毎日 (every day), 日曜日, 日本 (Japan).

一日|いちにち.note: A length of time: one whole day. 一日中 = all day long.

一日|ついたち.note: A date: the first of the month. 四月一日 (April 1st).

～人|～じん.note: Nationality or kind of person: 日本人, 外国人 (foreigner).

～人|～にん.note: Counting people from three up: 三人, 五人. (One and two are 一人 ひとり, 二人 ふたり.)

人|ひと.note: On its own: a person. あの人 (that person). Voiced as びと in 人々 ひとびと.

年|とし.note: On its own: a year, or someone's age. 年を取る (to get old).

～年|～ねん.note: After a number: a year or a count of years. 二〇二六年, 三年間 (for three years).

十|じゅう.note: The number ten, and in bigger numbers: 十五 (15), 三十 (30). Cut short in 十分 じゅっぷん (ten minutes).
examples: [部屋|へ|や]に[学生|がく|せい]が[十人|じゅう|にん]いる。
There are ten students in the room.
[十時|じゅう|じ]に[寝|ね]ます。
I go to bed at ten.

十|(〜を) とお.note: The native count of things, ten: like 一つ … 九つ, then 十 (とお) with no つ. Also in 十日 とおか (the 10th / ten days).
examples: りんごを[十|とお]ください。
Ten apples, please.
[十日|とお|か]に[会|あ]いましょう。
Let's meet on the 10th.

～本|～ほん.note: Counter for long, thin things (pens, bottles, trains). Sound changes: 一本 いっぽん, 三本 さんぼん.

～中|～じゅう.note: After a time or place: throughout, all over. 一日中 (all day), 世界中 (all over the world), 体中 (all over the body).
examples: [一日中|いち|にち|じゅう][雨|あめ]が[降|ふ]っていた。
It rained all day.
[世界中|せ|かい|じゅう]から[人|ひと]が[来|き]ます。
People come from all over the world.

～中|～ちゅう.note: After an action noun: in the middle of, during. 会議中 (in a meeting), 授業中 (during class), 工事中 (under construction).
examples: [父|ちち]は[今|いま]、[会議中|かい|ぎ|ちゅう]です。
My father is in a meeting now.
[授業中|じゅ|ぎょう|ちゅう]は[話|はな]さないでください。
Please don't talk during class.

中|なか.note: On its own: the inside, the middle. 箱の中 (inside the box), 雨の中 (in the rain).

中|ちゅう.note: Middle or medium in compounds: 中学 (junior high), 中心 (center), 中止 (calling off).

～時|～じ.note: After a number: the hour on the clock. 三時 (three o'clock), 何時 (what time).

～時|～とき.note: After a verb, adjective or noun + の: when ~, at the time of ~. 子供の時 (when I was a child).

～月|～がつ.note: After a number: a month of the year. 一月 (January), 十二月 (December).

～月|～つき.note: Counting months with native numbers: 一月 ひとつき (one month). With other numbers use ～か月: 三か月.

月|つき.note: On its own: the moon. 月がきれい (the moon is beautiful).

～分|～ふん.note: After a number: minutes. Sound changes: 一分 いっぷん, 三分 さんぷん, 十分 じゅっぷん.

分|ぶ.note: A rate or tenth: 三割五分 (35%), 五分五分 (fifty-fifty).

分|ぶん.note: A share or part: 自分 (oneself), 半分 (half), 十分 じゅうぶん (enough).

後|あと.note: Everyday word: after, later, the rest. 後で (later), 後五分 (five more minutes).

後|ご.note: After a time word, in compounds: 午後 (afternoon), 三年後 (three years later).

後|のち.note: Formal or written: afterwards. Weather forecasts: 晴れ後雨 (sunny, later rain).

前|まえ.note: On its own: in front, before. 駅の前 (in front of the station), 前に (before).

～前|～まえ.note: After a time or number: ~ ago, before ~. 三年前 (three years ago), 五分前 (five minutes to).

時間|じかん.note: On its own: time. 時間がない (there's no time).

～時間|～じかん.note: After a number: hours (length). 二時間 (two hours).

上|うえ.note: On its own: above, on top. 机の上 (on the desk).

上|じょう.note: In compounds: upper, top, first volume. 以上 (or more), 屋上 (rooftop), 上下 (top and bottom).

上|うわ.note: Before another word: outer, upper. 上着 (jacket), 上履き (indoor shoes).

上|かみ.note: Old or formal: upper part, upstream. 川上 (upstream).

方|かた.note: Polite word for a person (あの方), and after a verb stem: the way of doing. 読み方 (how to read).

方|ほう.note: A side or direction, and comparisons: こっちの方がいい (this one is better), 駅の方へ (towards the station).

四|し.note: Old reading, kept in a few words: 四月 しがつ (April), 四季. Often avoided since it sounds like 死 (death).

四|よん.note: The usual reading when counting: 四 (4), 四十 (40), 四人 よにん.

今日|こんにち.note: Formal: nowadays, the present day. Also in こんにちは.

九|きゅう.note: The usual reading: 九 (9), 九十 (90).

九|く.note: Used in a few words: 九時 くじ (nine o'clock), 九月 くがつ (September).

開く|あく.note: Intransitive: something opens by itself. ドアが開く (the door opens). Opposite of 閉まる.

開く|ひらく.note: To open (a book, an event, a flower): 本を開く, 会議を開く (hold a meeting).

明後日|あさって.note: Everyday word: the day after tomorrow.

明日|あす.note: A bit more formal: tomorrow (news, forecasts).

～円|～えん.note: After a number: yen. 百円 (100 yen).

円|えん.note: On its own: a circle, or the yen as a currency. 円が高い (the yen is strong).

円|まる.note: Native word for a circle (usually written 丸). 円を描く (draw a circle).

目|め.note: On its own: an eye. 目が痛い (my eyes hurt).

～目|～め.note: After a number + counter: the ~th. 二つ目 (the second), 三回目 (the third time).

外|そと.note: Outside, the exterior. 外で遊ぶ (play outside).

外|ほか.note: Other, else (usually written 他). 外の人 (someone else).

本当|ほんとう.note: Standard form: true, real. 本当に (really).

本当|ほんと.note: Casual spoken form of ほんとう. ほんと？ (Really?)

下|した.note: On its own: under, below. 机の下 (under the desk).

下|しも.note: Old or formal: lower part, downstream. 川下 (downstream).

下|げ.note: In compounds: low, last volume. 下車 (getting off), 上下 (top and bottom).

～度|～ど.note: After a number: times, or degrees. 二度 (twice), 三十度 (30 degrees).

度|たび.note: Each time ~: 会う度に (every time we meet).

家|いえ.note: On its own: a house, home. Also read うち for 'home'.

～家|～か.note: After a field: a person who does it. 作家 (writer), 画家 (painter).

在る|ある.note: To exist, for things. Usually written in kana: ある.

在る; 有る|ある.note: 有る: to have, to possess. Usually written in kana: ある.

町|まち.note: On its own: a town, a neighbourhood.

～町|～ちょう.note: After a name: the town of ~, a district in an address.
examples: [私|わたし]は[本町|ほん|ちょう]に[住|す]んでいます。
I live in Honchō.

キロ; キログラム|キロ; キログラム.note: Weight: キロ is short for キログラム. 三キロ (3 kg).

キロ; キロメートル|キロ; キロメートル.note: Distance: キロ is also short for キロメートル. 五キロ走る (run 5 km).

そう; そうです|そう; そうです.note: Agreeing: そうです (that's right). After a verb stem: looks like (降りそう).

そう|そう.note: Reacting: そう？ (Really?), そうか (I see). Also 'so, like that': そう思う.

何|なん; なに.note: なに on its own and before most particles (何を); なん before d-, t-, n- sounds and counters: 何ですか, 何人.

何～|なん～.note: Before a counter: how many ~. 何時 (what time), 何回 (how many times).

夜|よ.note: In compounds or poetic: 夜中 (midnight), 夜が明ける (day breaks).

角|かど.note: An outer corner: 角を曲がる (turn the corner).

角|すみ.note: An inner corner (usually written 隅): 部屋の隅 (corner of the room).
examples: [部屋|へ|や]の[角|すみ]に[机|つくえ]を[置|お]いた。
I put the desk in the corner of the room.

角|かく.note: An angle, in maths: 三角 (triangle), 四角 (square).

辛い|からい.note: Of taste: spicy, hot; also salty.

辛い|つらい.note: Of feeling: painful, hard to bear.

間|あいだ.note: Between, during: 駅と家の間 (between the station and home), 夏休みの間 (during summer break).

間|ま.note: A gap or pause, a room: 間に合う (be in time), 居間 (living room).

市|し.note: A city as a unit of government: 横浜市 (Yokohama City).

市|いち.note: A market or fair: 朝市 (morning market).

表|おもて.note: The front or outside: 紙の表 (front of the paper), 表に出る (go outside).

表|ひょう.note: A table or chart: 時間表 (timetable).

下る|さがる.note: Usually written 下がる: to go down, drop. 熱が下がる (the fever goes down).
下る|さがる.meaning: to go down, to drop (下がる)

下る|くだる.note: To go down a slope or river: 坂を下る (go down a slope).

都|と.note: The metropolis, Tokyo: 東京都, 都内 (inside Tokyo).

都|みやこ.note: A capital (old or poetic): 京の都 (the old capital, Kyoto).

～続ける|～つづける.note: After a verb stem: keep doing ~. 歩き続ける (keep walking).
examples: [彼|かれ]は[一時間|いち|じ|かん][歩|ある]き[続|つづ]けた。
He kept walking for an hour.

続ける|つづける.note: On its own: to continue something. 勉強を続ける.

打つ|うつ.note: To hit, strike: ボールを打つ, キーを打つ (type).

打つ|ぶつ.note: Casual: to hit a person (usually written ぶつ).

始める|はじめる.note: On its own: to start something. 仕事を始める.

～始める|～はじめる.note: After a verb stem: start doing ~. 雨が降り始めた (it started to rain).
examples: [雨|あめ]が[降|ふ]り[始|はじ]めました。
It started to rain.
[祖父|そ|ふ]は[小|ちい]さな[工場|こう|ば]で[働|はたら]いていた。
My grandfather worked in a small workshop.

空く|あく.note: To become empty or free: 席が空く (a seat frees up), 時間が空く.

空く|すく.note: To be uncrowded, or hungry: 電車が空いている, お腹が空いた (I'm hungry).
空く|すく.meaning: to be uncrowded; to get hungry

止める|やめる.note: To quit or give up a habit or plan (often written やめる): たばこを止める.

止める|とめる.note: To stop something moving: 車を止める (stop / park the car).

運転|うんてんする.note: As a verb with する: to drive. 車を運転する.
examples: [父|ちち]は[毎日|まい|にち][車|くるま]を[運転|うん|てん]します。
My father drives a car every day.

運転|うんてん.note: As a noun: driving, running a machine. 運転免許 (driver's license).

音|おと.note: A sound (not a voice): ドアの音.

音|おん.note: In compounds: sound, a reading: 音楽 (music), 発音 (pronunciation).

音|ね.note: Poetic: tone of an instrument or insect. 虫の音.

～様|～さま.note: After a name: very polite Mr./Ms. お客様 (customer).

様|よう.note: Way, manner, like: このように (like this), 〜ようだ (it seems).

君|きみ.note: 'You', casual, to someone of equal or lower status.

～君|～くん.note: After a name: for boys or junior men. 田中君.

訳|わけ.note: Reason, meaning: 訳がわからない (it makes no sense). Grammar: わけだ, わけがない.

訳|やく.note: A translation: 日本語訳 (Japanese translation).

～軒|～けん.note: After a number: counter for houses and shops. 三軒 (three houses).

軒|のき.note: On its own: the eaves of a roof.

日本|にっぽん.note: Emphatic or official: sports cheers, stamps, 日本銀行.

行き|いき.note: Going: 東京行き (bound for Tokyo). Everyday reading.

行き|ゆき.note: Going: same as いき, more written (on train signs).

年月|としつき.note: Months and years, the passage of time (soft, literary).

年月|ねんげつ.note: Months and years, a long time (formal).

生|せい.note: Life, living: 人生 (one's life), 学生 (student).

生|なま.note: Raw, live: 生ビール (draft beer), 生の魚.

対|たい.note: Versus, against, in scores: 三対二 (3 to 2), 日本対ブラジル.

対|つい.note: A pair, a set of two: 一対の花瓶 (a pair of vases).

金|きん.note: Gold: 金メダル (gold medal); and Friday: 金曜日.

不|ふ.note: Prefix un-, non-: 不便 (inconvenient), 不安 (anxiety).

不|ぶ.note: The same prefix in a few words: 不気味 (eerie), 不用心 (careless).

数|すう.note: Number, as a prefix or in compounds: 数人 (several people), 数学 (maths).

数|かず.note: On its own: the number of things. 数が多い (many in number).

得る|える.note: Standard: to get, gain. 許可を得る (get permission).

得る|うる.note: Mainly after a verb stem, meaning 'can, possible': あり得る (it's possible).

品|しな.note: On its own: goods, an article. 品物 (goods).

品|ひん.note: Grace, elegance: 品がある (elegant); and in compounds: 食品 (food products).

無|む.note: Nothing, zero: 無料 (free of charge), 無理 (impossible).

無|ぶ.note: The same prefix in a few words: 無事 (safe), 無難 (safe choice).

球|きゅう.note: A sphere, in compounds: 地球 (the earth), 野球 (baseball).

球|たま.note: On its own: a ball (also written 玉). 球を投げる (throw a ball).

額|がく.note: An amount of money, or a picture frame: 金額 (sum of money).

末|すえ.note: On its own: the end of a period, or 'after a long ~': 今月の末 (end of this month), 考えた末 (after much thought).

末|まつ.note: End, in compounds: 週末 (weekend), 年末 (end of the year).

文字|もじ.note: Everyday reading: a letter, a character.

文字|もんじ.note: Old reading, in set phrases only.

注ぐ|そそぐ.note: To pour into, or to flow into; also to devote (力を注ぐ).

注ぐ|つぐ.note: To pour a drink for someone: お茶を注ぐ.

管|くだ.note: Native word: a pipe or tube.

管|かん.note: In compounds: 水道管 (water pipe), 血管 (blood vessel).

他|た.note: In compounds or formal: その他 (and others), 他人 (other people).

他|ほか.note: Everyday: other, else. 他の人 (someone else).

為る|する.note: To do. Almost always written in kana: する.
examples: [宿題|しゅく|だい]を[為|す]る。
I do my homework.

為る|なる.note: To become. Almost always written in kana: なる.

抱く|いだく.note: Written: to hold feelings or hopes. 夢を抱く (have a dream).

抱く|だく.note: Everyday: to hold in your arms, to hug. 赤ちゃんを抱く.

描く|えがく.note: To depict, also in words or the mind: 未来を描く.

描く|かく.note: Everyday: to draw a picture. 絵を描く.

節|ふし.note: A knot or joint (bamboo), a melody.

節|せつ.note: A section or paragraph; an occasion: その節は (on that occasion).

柄|がら.note: A pattern on fabric, or someone's build or nature: 花柄 (floral pattern).

梅雨|ばいう.note: In weather reports: 梅雨前線 (seasonal rain front).

縁|えん.note: A bond or fate between people: ご縁 (a connection).

縁|ふち.note: An edge or rim: 眼鏡の縁 (frame of glasses).

唯|たった.note: Only, just, with numbers: たった一人 (just one person).

綿|めん.note: Cotton cloth: 綿のシャツ (a cotton shirt).

綿|わた.note: Raw cotton, stuffing: 綿あめ (cotton candy).

頬|ほほ.note: Cheek (a little more formal or written).

方々|かたがた.note: Polite plural of 方: people. 先生方.

examples: [一月|ひと|つき]に[一回|いっ|かい]、[映画|えい|が]を[見|み]に[行|い]きます。
I go to see a movie once a month.
[九日|ここの|か]は[私|わたし]の[誕生日|たん|じょう|び]です。
The 9th is my birthday.
さ[来年|らい|ねん]、[日本|に|ほん]に[行|い]きたいです。
I want to go to Japan the year after next.
お[茶|ちゃ]をどうぞ。
Please have some tea.
お[名前|な|まえ]は[何|なん]ですか。
What is your name?

I listen to music on an old radio cassette player.

[再来月|さ|らい|げつ]に[引|ひ]っ[越|こ]します。
I'm moving the month after next.
[母|はは]はスーパーでパートをしています。

No matter how much I eat, I don't gain weight.

I've finished reading this book.
スーパーで[野菜|や|さい]を[買|か]いました。
I bought vegetables at the supermarket.
[日本|に|ほん]の[文化|ぶん|か]について[話|はな]しましょう。

この[時計|と|けい]はスイス[製|せい]です。

[箱|はこ]の[中味|なか|み]は[何|なん]ですか。
What's inside the box?

This typeface is easy to read.
[彼|かれ]は[才能|さい|のう]を[具|そな]えている。
He is endowed with talent.
[事故|じ|こ]は[不注意|ふ|ちゅう|い]に[因|よ]るものだった。
The accident was due to carelessness.
この[粉|こな]はケーキの[素|もと]です。
This powder is cake mix.
[山|やま]の[水|みず]は[清|す]んでいる。

This magazine is a quarterly.

[新|あたら]しい[仕事|し|ごと]に[馴|な]れてきた。

[濠|ほり]に[白鳥|はく|ちょう]がいる。
